cooperate_until_defection
</NAME>

<DESCRIPTION>
Begins cooperatively to secure sustained mutual-payoff outcomes against reciprocal opponents. Once the opponent defects even once, it switches permanently to action 1, avoiding repeated exploitation by defecting opponents.
</DESCRIPTION>
